mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% indicates sustained monetary accommodation, reducing discount rates for equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL year-over-year inflation exceeding 2.5% signals persistent inflation, triggering Fed rate hikes that compress equity valuations and produce negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in >60% of CPIAUCSL YoY >2.5% periods, or Rank IC <0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in unemployment rate and employment growth indicate labor market tightening that pressures wage growth and prompts Fed policy tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: Joint UNRATE/PAYEMS decline fails to produce negative 20-day returns in >60% of cases, or interaction Rank IC <0.03 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 1.0 million units signal weak residential demand, indicating slowing economic activity that reduces corporate earnings growth and drives negative S&P 500 returns during late-cycle expansion.
failure_condition: HOUST <1000.0 fails to produce negative 20-day returns in >60% of cases, or Rank IC <0.03 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production decline exceeding 0.5% signals manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate output capacity and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: INDPRO decline >0.5% fails to produce negative 20-day returns in >60% of cases, or Rank IC <0.03 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: GDP growth exceeding 3.0% quarterly indicates robust economic expansion, supporting corporate earnings and generating positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 QoQ >3.0% fails to produce positive 60-day returns in >60% of cases, or Rank IC <0.03 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS increases signal active monetary tightening to combat inflation, raising discount rates and reducing equity valuations for negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: Joint CPIAUCSL/FEDFUNDS increase fails to produce negative 20-day returns in >60% of cases, or interaction Rank IC <0.03 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate above 5.0% combined with rising real sales (RSAFS growth >1.0%) indicates accommodative labor market conditions that delay Fed tightening, supporting positive S&P 500 returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: UNRATE>5.0% and RSAFS growth>1.0% fails to produce positive 5-day returns in >60% of cases, or interaction Rank IC <0.03 over 3-year window.
